SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C.
C. & S. I. REGS.
No. S. B. D. 1961.
cte 13 - 3 - 31.

March 13, 31.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of
your letters dated January 14 and February 27,
1931 on the subject of one Elias Sassoon Joseph,
and to state in reply that careful inquiries
have been made, but no confirmation can be found
of the statement that this man once stopped in
Shanghai. The "Kashima Maru", which arrived in
Singapore on February 12 left Shanghai on
February 3. The list of passengers who left here
by that ship has been scrutinised, but the name of
Elias Sassoon Joseph does not appear among them.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
D. C. (C.&S.B)
for Commissioner of Police.

Chief Police Officer,
Straits Settlements,
Singapore.

[Signature]

上海公共租界工部局
刑事侦缉处规章
编号 S. B. D. 1961。
cte 13 - 3 - 31。

1931年3月13日。

先生：

兹确认收到阁下于1931年1月14日及2月27日就一名叫 Elias Sassoon Joseph 之人士事宜所发来函，并谨此回复称，经仔细查询，未能找到证实此人曾停留于上海的记录。“鹿岛丸”（Kashima Maru）轮于2月12日抵达新加坡，该轮于2月3日离开上海。已仔细核查搭乘该轮离开上海的乘客名单，但其中并未出现 Elias Sassoon Joseph 之名。

此致
敬礼

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
D. C. (刑事侦缉处)
代警务处长。

海峡殖民地首席警务官，
新加坡。

[签名]

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No._______
8. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date March 13, 1931.
Subject (in full) Elias Sassoon Joseph.
Made by D.P.S. Moore. Forwarded by Whouncan WBJ.
Sir,
All enquiries concerning the above named
individual's supposed arrival and residence in this city
have proved abortive. Nothing has been learned of the
opening locally of a branch of the firm of F. Homes &
Co. Ltd., general commission agents of Singapore. Neither
does Joseph's name appear on the list of passengers who
left Shanghai per the S.S. "Kashima Maru" on February
3rd 1931.
D.P.S. Moore.
D. P. S.

accordance with attached draft.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to my
letter, dated January 27, in reply to yours of
January 14, on the subject of one Elias Sassoon
Joseph and to state that the s.s. "Talma" arrived
in Shanghai on January 20. Enquiries show that
the name of Joseph does not appear on the passenger
list. It has, however, been ascertained that the
steerage passengers, who came to Shanghai by the
ship, and whose names were not taken, included three
Jews. It is possible that one of these was named
Joseph, and efforts are now being made to obtain
confirmation of this suspicion.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

for Commissioner of Police.

Singapore.

首席警务官办公室，

新加坡，1931年1月14日。

先生，

我很荣幸地随函附上出生于新加坡的犹太人 Elias Sassoon Joseph 的照片及犯罪记录，此人于1931年1月7日乘坐“塔尔马”号轮船从新加坡前往上海。

* 先生，
特别分支登记处无记录。
26/1。

据告知，他访问上海的目的是为了开设新加坡一般佣金代理商 F. Hommes & Co. Ltd. 公司的分行。这是一家非常可疑的公司。

Joseph 是一名商业“骗子”，专门从事长期诈骗（long firm frauds）。他是本地尚未解除破产状态的人，并在未经官方接管人许可的情况下离开了殖民地。

然而，官方接管人目前不希望对他采取行动。

如蒙适时提供有关其活动的信息，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

您顺从的仆人，

首席警务官。

警务处长，
上海公共租界警务处，
上海。

Previous Convictions of Elias Sassoon Joseph.
Sentenced on 21st. February, 1919 at the District Court,
Singapore, to a fine of $1,000/- or 2 months' R.I. for
being concerned in the removal of Chandu into the Colony.

Fine paid.

------------------

Sentenced on 31st May, 1926 at the District Court,
Singapore to 3 months' R.I. for obtaining credit under
false pretences. Section 110 (1) (a) Ord: 44 Bank-
ruptcy.

------ --------

Sentanced on 6th. September, 1927 at the Supreme Court,
Singapore, on 3 charges of Cheating to 1 year's R.I.
on each charge, to run concurrently.

--------------

Arrested on 30/4/29 and charged for leaving the Colony
without the permission of the Official Assignee.
Section 109 (1) of Ord: 44 Bankruptcy. This case was
withdrawn by the D.P.P. on 16.5.29.

==============
pages.zh:
Elias Sassoon Joseph 的前科记录。
1919年2月21日在新加坡地方法院被判处罚款1,000元或两个月苦役，罪名是参与将鸦片烟膏（Chandu）运入殖民地。

罚款已缴。

------------------

1926年5月31日在新加坡地方法院判处三个月苦役，罪名是以虚假借口获取信用。依据《破产条例》第44号第110(1)(a)条。

------ --------

1927年9月6日在新加坡最高法院因三项欺诈罪被判处每项罪名一年苦役，同期执行。

--------------

1929年4月30日被捕，被控未经官方接管人许可离开殖民地。依据《破产条例》第44号第109(1)条。此案于1929年5月16日由副检察长撤回。

==============
